findings.evidence: EU retention is now 24 months for all EU accounts, effective 1 September 2026
findings.why_it_matters: This uses the unsigned draft as current and overstates the position; Draft Amendment B is not approved.

findings.evidence: The Board approved Draft Amendment B in January 2026
findings.why_it_matters: The Board did not approve Draft Amendment B; it delegated signature of Amendment A.

findings.evidence: All EU accounts, including those opened before 2026, move to 18 months
findings.why_it_matters: Amendment A applies only to accounts opened on or after 1 January 2026; older accounts remain at 12 months.

findings.evidence: Backups are covered by the 18-month retention period
findings.why_it_matters: Backups are retained for 35 days under a separate schedule and are out of scope of the retention policy.

findings.evidence: Proceed with the Q3 launch without updating the system export
findings.why_it_matters: The export is stale for accounts opened on or after 1 January 2026; operations must update the configuration before launch.
